question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

‘A person who is overly concerned with trivial details’.
solution: The correct answer is: **Pedant**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Pedant"** refers to a person who is overly concerned with minor details, rules, or academic learning, often in a way that is annoying to others. (पांडित्य प्रदर्शन करने वाला) • **Example: **The professor was such a pedant that he corrected every single grammatical mistake in the students' essays, no matter how trivial. • **"Overly concerned with trivial details"** describes someone who focuses excessively on insignificant or minor aspects, often missing the bigger picture. (तुच्छ बातों पर अधिक ध्यान देना) • **Example: **Instead of discussing the main idea of the presentation, he kept pointing out small formatting errors in the slides. • Hence, the correct one-word substitution for a person who is overly concerned with trivial details is **'Pedant'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pedant**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Analyst** (विश्लेषक): A person who examines and interprets data or information to understand a particular subject or solve a problem. • **Example:** The financial analyst reviewed the company's performance to provide investment advice. • **Linguist** (भाषाविद्): A person who is skilled in or studies multiple languages or the structure of language. • **Example:** The linguist was fluent in seven languages and specialized in ancient dialects. • **Reviewer** (समीक्षक): A person who evaluates or critiques work such as books, movies, or performances. • **Example:** The reviewer gave a glowing critique of the new film, praising its direction and acting. 34:T6cc, The correct answer is** option 3.**
